title: Fix MemoryScorer weights to sum to 1.0
description:
P1 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-003). MemoryScorer weights (0.63+0.3+0.2+0.1) sum to 1.23, not 1.0. Score is an unbounded linear combination, not a weighted average. UsageCount=1000 contributes ~1.89 from usage alone, easily exceeding CoreThreshold=2.0. Normalize weights to sum to 1.0 or document that scores are unbounded and adjust thresholds accordingly.

File: MemorySmith.Core/StateMachine/MemoryScorer.cs (lines 10-13)
Confidence: 100%
